headline: Senegal: Cheikh Diba, a finance minister tested by a political and budgetary storm
summary: Senegal's Treasury confirmed on November 23, 2026 that it paid on time a coupon of about 18.7 billion CFA francs ($31.25 million) on its 2033 sovereign bonds, amid budget tensions.
why: Timely debt service is key to market access for frontier sovereigns, and Senegal has faced scrutiny over its public finances.
original_headline: Sénégal : Cheikh Diba, un argentier à l’épreuve d’une tempête politico-budgétaire
